verdict.rationale: Twenty ships a documented, developer-first REST and GraphQL API with auto-generated per-workspace documentation, an interactive playground, a Metadata API for programmatic schema changes, webhooks, and API-based import/export, plus community hands-on confirmation that the REST API works. This clearly satisfies driving the product through a documented public API; missing for 10: independent verification of a stable public OpenAPI spec (probe found no static openapi.json) and deeper third-party corroboration beyond one HN mention.
